name: sqlprojectreader-legacy-deploy-overlap
body: BuildScopes takes a legacy project's members as exactly its Build Include items minus its Build Remove items, so a file a legacy project lists both as Build and as PreDeploy or PostDeploy stays a project member; only an SDK-style project subtracts its None, PreDeploy and PostDeploy items. Upgrade if deployment scripts must be loose even when a legacy project also builds them.
